title:
Implements {@link UiSdlRenderCondition} for conditional component rendering.

If specified in {@link UiSdlConditionalRenderer#condition}, it will render the `thenComponent` when the user has
selected the "Conversations" page in the GenAiUi.HistoryPageSegmentedButton, otherwise it will render the Query
History.
